changelog: **Security: the SP signing key stays on the server; template subjects hold no markup.** `POST` and `PATCH /api/admin/organizations` answered with the whole Organization row, so since #1952 the sealed private half of the org's SAML SP signing key (`ssoSpKey`) reached the admin's browser; both responses now go through `withoutOrgCredentials()` (`src/lib/orgCredentials.ts`, the list of credential columns), pinned by a new @smoke case in `e2e/admin-organizations.spec.ts`. The notification-template renderer (#1718) stripped subject tags in one pass and decoded entities afterwards, so a nested (`<<b>script>`) or encoded (`<img …>`) tag left markup in the subject; `stripTags()` now removes tags until none is left and drops stray angle brackets, entities are decoded first, and the empty-body check uses the same function — the two CodeQL `js/incomplete-multi-character-sanitization` alerts on `templateRender.ts`.
